name: dsdv_gunit_l0
structural_change: S81U-GUNIT6 (10-17): native pin rules -- rst_n drives only ot_rst_relay ; cw captured once (feedthrough stage 1 = job-decode input flops); j_v output flop has a kept internal twin (0 data edges). S81U-GUNIT3 (10-17): dsdv_gunit_l0 successor: the root store (12,288 flops) moved to the E-side leaf dsdv_gunit_l0r (GUNIT2 L0: 15,319 sinks, TT insertion 333 ps, clock-rule FAIL). L0 keeps the window bookkeeping, HC job hand-over, rung / cw / CTL / sid passes and relays L0r's group stream to L4 (+4 edges on the HC path, off the router path). Pins at 4 tracks (<= 5.2 pins/um), clock on the free W face.

job.purpose: S81-DV G-unit leaf L0 to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: every input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop (dsdv_gunit_l* input/output flops, dsdv_gunit_pass feedthroughs, ot_dsdv_vstop's own flops); recipe pin_regs would add an unpriced stage on the router's critical path and on every rung hop.
